actual: Production SimulationLifecycleScheduler invokes StrategyPackageSelectionService with runtime_config={} when processing StrategyRuntimeRelease bindings, so unattended LocalSim/MiniQMT multi-strategy runs cannot find the authoritative selection artifact for the release runtime hash (observed runtime_config_hash=44136... instead of the 2026-06-04 package runtime hashes) and fail before plan/submit. This blocks unattended AIstock LocalSim and MiniQMT multi-strategy simulation validation.
